title: Small Commercial Real Estate Equity Stake For Sale in Kurunegala, Sri Lanka
tagline: Owner-backed commercial redevelopment opportunity in Kurunegala, Sri Lanka, seeking an operating partner and investor rather than offering an existing operating business. - The road-facing commercial property is located in an active commercial area and is currently rented to a grocery shop. - The property is suitable for compact retail, branded packaged foods, parcel and collection services, e-commerce fulfilment, distribution, quick-service formats, or another suitable commercial concept. - The final operating concept will be selected jointly with the investor based on operating expertise, investment capacity, and local market demand. - The proposed structure is a joint venture offering up to 49% equity in a yet-to-be-incorporated company, with an estimated transaction value of approximately LKR 50 million, subject to independent valuation and mutually agreed terms. - Investment will be used for renovation or construction of a purpose-built commercial building, interior fit-out, equipment, required licenses, opening inventory, initial marketing, and working capital. - The property has three-phase electricity, water, and an existing commercial structure that can either be renovated or replaced. - The proposed business is expected to initially employ approximately 3–5 staff once operations commence. - The property owner is willing to contribute the property for business use and may also provide additional cash investment. - The promoter has family and business connections in Japan and New Zealand that may support future international business development. - The preferred partner should have verifiable investment capacity, relevant operating experience, and the ability to manage day-to-day operations in Sri Lanka. - The existing grocery shop operates with approval from the local Pradeshiya Sabha and follows applicable requirements. - Fire, building, and business approvals will be obtained before opening, based on the final business concept selected.
